Execution for Sale of Mortgaged Premises
By virtue of the above stated writ of Execution, to me directed, I shall expose for sale by Public Auction in SHERIFF'S OFFICE, Essex County Courts Building in Newark, on Tuesday, July 21, 2026, at one-thirty P.M. (Prevailing Time)
Commonly known as:
10-14 KENT STREET NEWARK, NJ 07108
TAX LOT NO. 28 IN BLOCK NO. 2613
DIMENSION OF LOT APPROXIMATELY: 96.75 X 74.05
NEAREST CROSS STREET: EIGHTEENTH AVENUE
GOOD FAITH ESTIMATE OF UPSET PRICE: $5,565,327.91
THE OCCUPANCY STATUS OF THE PROPERTY BEING FORECLOSED HEREIN IS PRESENTLY UNKNOWN.
BEGINNING AT A POINT IN THE EASTERLY SIDE OF KENT STREET, MEASURED SOUTHERLY ALONG SAID SIDE, 97.08 FEET FROM THE INTERSECTION OF SAID SIDE OF KENT STREET WITH THE SOUTHERLY SIDE OF EIGHTEENTH AVENUE: THENCE
PRIOR LIENS/ENCUMBRANCES:
2025 TAXES OPEN PLUS PENALTY $51,403.13
1ST QUARTER TAXES OPEN PLUS PENALTY $15,496.13
2ND QUARTER OPEN PLUS PENALTY $15,496.13
WATER OPEN PLUS PENALTY $18,830.51
MISCELLANEOUS YEAR END PENALTY OPEN PLUS PENALTY: $9,860.01
TOTAL AS OF JUNE 1, 2026 $111,085.91
A full legal description can be found in the office of the Register of Essex County.
A DEPOSIT OF 20% OF THE BID PRICE IN CERTIFIED FUNDS IS REQUIRED AT THE TIME OF SALE.
SURPLUS MONEY: IF AFTER THE SALE AND SATISFACTION OF THE MORTGAGE DEBT, INCLUDING COSTS AND EXPENSES, THERE REMAINS ANY SURPLUS MONEY, THE MONEY WILL BE DEPOSITED INTO THE SUPERIOR COURT TRUST FUND AND ANY PERSON CLAIMING THE SURPLUS, OR ANY PART THEREOF, MAY FILE A MOTION PURSUANT TO COURT RULES 4:64-3 AND 4:57-2 STATING THE NATURE AND EXTENT OF THAT PERSON’S CLAIM AND ASKING FOR AN ORDER DIRECTING PAYMENT OF THE SURPLUS MONEY. THE SHERIFF OR OTHER PERSON CONDUCTING THE SALE WILL HAVE INFORMATION REGARDING THE SURPLUS, IF ANY.
The approximate amount of the Judgment to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of $5,825,606.85, together with the costs of this sale. The Sheriff reserves the right to adjourn the sale from time to time as provided by Law
Newark, N.J. June 16, 2026
AMIR D. JONES, Sheriff
FEIN, SUCH, KAHN & SHEPARD, P.C., ATTORNEY(S)
